task.payload: {"metadata":{"description":"Unified portal for DeepSeek Harness plugins by sunshine-lang: dsh-weather, dsh-pdf, dsh-plugin-template","id":"gh:1333788707","install_available":false,"language":null,"name":"dsh-plugins","slug":"sunshine-lang/dsh-plugins","topics":["deepseek-harness","dsh-plugin","dsh-plugins"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"Unified portal for DeepSeek Harness plugins by sunshine-lang: dsh-weather, dsh-pdf, dsh-plugin-templ"},{"id":"p1s2","text":"fied portal for DeepSeek Harness plugins by sunshine-lang: dsh-weather, dsh-pdf, dsh-plugin-template"},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# DeepSeek Harness 插件总入口"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"English | 中文"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"这是 sunshine-lang 开发的 DeepSeek Harness（`dsh`）插件统一入口。一切皆插件——下面的插件都可以一条命令安装。"},{"id":"p5s1","text":"## 插件列表"},{"id":"p6s1","text":"| 插件 | 功能 | 安装 |"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"| dsh-weather | 任意城市实时天气与多日预报，数据来自 Open-Meteo（免费，无需 API key） | `dsh plugin --profile web add \"github"},{"id":"p7s2","text":":sunshine-lang/dsh-weather\"` |\n| dsh-pdf | PDF 工具箱：提取文本、元数据与页码范围，基于 pdfjs-dist（本地解析，无需 API key） | `d"},{"id":"p7s3","text":"sh plugin --profile web add \"github:sunshine-lang/dsh-pdf\"` |\n| dsh-plugin-template | 新插件脚手架：bundle "},{"id":"p7s4","text":"格式、工具 DSL、配置、测试，一条命令生成 | `git clone https://github.com/sunshine-lang/dsh-plugin-template` |"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"所有插件都打上了 `dsh-plugin` 话题，也已发布到 npm，可直接安装："},{"id":"p9s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"## 生态状态"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"- awesome-deepseek-harness 收录 PR：dsh-weather #49、dsh-pdf #52 —— 等待维护者合并。"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"## 自己做一个"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"这里每个插件都由 dsh-plugin-template 脚手架生成："},{"id":"p14s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"完整的发布清单（bundle 清单、提交 `lib/`、`dsh-plugin` 话题、awesome 列表 PR）见模板的 README。"}],"truncated":false}
